title: The ledger's ui move lists by hand the steps `make viewer-repin` now takes
foundBy: agent review (session): ledger's new `make viewer-repin` covers the steps deps-config.json lists for its ui pin
details: For ledger's `@codesweep-ai/ui` pin, deps-config.json names `internal/ledger/render.go`'s `UIVersion` as a second place the pin is written. After the install it lists four more steps: raise `RendererVersion` by hand, `make viewer-build build`, render both ledgers, and edit the sample line in MANUAL.md. Ledger's `make viewer-repin` now does all of it, and a test in ledger holds `UIVersion` to the pin. A person who follows the page's steps does by hand what one target does, and can miss the version bump that target makes.
